# @voidable/ui-alpine

> Alpine.js plugin and Livewire morph protection for Voidable UI web components.

## Install and use

```sh
npm install @voidable/ui @voidable/theme @voidable/ui-alpine
```

```js
import Alpine from 'alpinejs';
import { VoidableAlpine, registerLivewireHooks } from '@voidable/ui-alpine';

Alpine.plugin(VoidableAlpine);   // adds x-void-on and x-void-preserve
registerLivewireHooks();         // with Livewire: keeps client state across morphs
Alpine.start();
```

## API

- `VoidableAlpine`: Alpine plugin. `x-void-on:<event>="expr"` listens for a Voidable event (`x-void-on:void-change="name = $event.detail.value"`); `x-void-preserve` adds `wire:ignore` so Livewire skips the element and its children.
- `registerLivewireHooks()`: Livewire morph protection; reflected state survives while the server renders the same value.
- The Laravel package `voidable/laravel` wraps both (`void_attrs()`, `@voidableScripts`).

## Full reference

Every `<void-*>` element (parts, attributes with allowed values, events with `detail`, examples) is in the core package: `@voidable/ui/reference.md` (`node_modules/@voidable/ui/dist/reference.md`), summarised in `@voidable/ui/llms.txt`. Online: https://voidable.dev/llms.txt. Offline per element: `voidable ref <tag>`.
